change.task: PR #793 (issue #791 work item 6): soak gates of the cost-accounting release train
change.origin: Issue #791 requires that a ca/ pull request merges into ca-canary only after its 22-hour soak, and that ca-release passes the 60-hour soak before it gets a ca-v tag. PR #792 added the Mergify ca-item queue, which requires the ca-soaked label, and just ca-tag, which requires a successful Soak Gate (60h) status. This change adds the soak runs and the statuses and the label that those two gates read. Two multi-agent reviews of PR #793 then found a race in the ca-soaked label add, a stale label after a failed manual rerun, and a cancel search that read only 100 runs. Commit d1d691d58 fixes all three.

commits.change: merge-recovery-soak.yml gets the inputs gate and gate_pr. A gate run soaks an exact SHA for 22 hours (ca-item) or 60 hours (ca-release), has its own concurrency group and runner label, publishes no checkpoint or series, and restarts once with a full window. Two jobs post the Soak Gate status. report-soak-gate.sh decides the result and the ca-soaked label. ca-soak-dispatch.yml and ca-soak-dispatch.sh start and invalidate the soaks.

report-soak-gate.sh reads the pull request head again after it adds ca-soaked and removes the label if the head moved. A final ca-item result that is not a success removes ca-soaked when the head is still the soaked commit. A failed pull request read fails the report. ca-soak-dispatch.sh cancels the queued and running item soaks on every page of each status that is not completed, and a failed listing fails the push handler. merge-recovery-soak.yml and ca-soak-dispatch.yml do not change.

change.unchanged: The daily and weekend soaks keep their schedule, concurrency groups, runner label, checkpoints, dashboard series, and window restart. test-soak-schedule-routing.sh and check-workflow-invariants.sh pass without change.
